'''Crispos Isle''' was an island in the equatorial ocean of [[Procopia/Legends|Procopia]] in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]]. It is owned by [[House Barnaba]] and used during [[Capital Season]] to host events such as the [[Unification Gala]].
